sections.description: The ultimate white-label minimalist CRM for real estate agencies.
sections.changelog:
1.5.0

  • Onboarding default role fallback changed to Workspace Super Admin / Owner.
  • Added user onboarding settings and Google OAuth integration.
  • Added custom landing page modal popup with quick email-only registration and SSO.
  • Added workspace custom roles creation with live Permissions Matrix mapping.
  • Added in-app single-click updates directly from the sidebar profile panel.
